description:
Welcome to Sherlock Quarter, Birmingham's exciting new rental neighbourhood, offering a collection of beautifully designed one, two and three-bedroom apartments in the heart of the city's thriving Southside. Blending contemporary architecture with exceptional resident amenities, Sherlock Quarter redefines modern renting with thoughtfully designed homes and vibrant community spaces.

Each apartment has been carefully crafted to maximise light, space and comfort, featuring open-plan living areas, stylish kitchens with integrated appliances, elegant bathrooms, generous storage and high-quality finishes throughout. Designed for modern lifestyles, these homes provide the perfect balance of style and practicality.

Residents enjoy an outstanding range of exclusive amenities, creating an extension of your home and enhancing everyday living.

Guide Prices (Subject to Availability)

1 Bedroom Apartments – from £1,294 pcm

Ideally located on Sherlock Street between Digbeth and Highgate, Sherlock Quarter places you within walking distance of Birmingham New Street Station, the Bullring Shopping Centre, Grand Central and the city's renowned restaurants, cafés, bars and cultural destinations. Digbeth's creative quarter, the city's business district and excellent transport connections are all within easy reach.

Designed around community and wellbeing, Sherlock Quarter offers landscaped public spaces, regular resident events and a welcoming neighbourhood where work, relaxation and social life come together.

Whether you're searching for your first home, more space to work remotely or a premium city-centre lifestyle, Sherlock Quarter offers an exceptional rental experience in one of Birmingham's most exciting new destinations.

Images shown may be of a show apartment and are for illustrative purposes only. Apartment layouts, specifications, furnishings and views may vary. Prices and availability are subject to change without notice.
